sourceSteps: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部，同时将上半身卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低肩胛骨并将双腿伸展回起始位置。

observation: Actually viewed start and endpoint: bent-knee feet-flat supine start transitions to both bent knees lifted toward chest and small shoulder curl, paws behind head and elbows open; low back and pelvis stay grounded, no sit-up or straight-leg raise.
scope: One reversible tuck-crunch forward curling and bent-knee tuck preview, with return synthesized by exact reversed frames after review.
